mechanism: Amphetamine increases sympathomimetic activity and norepinephrine release while amitriptyline inhibits norepinephrine reuptake, creating additive sympathomimetic effects and increasing risk of hypertension, tachycardia, and arrhythmias.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider alternative ADHD medications or use combination only with careful dose titration and cardiac monitoring; educate patient on warning signs of hypertensive crisis.
